interface.signature: def leastInterval(N: int, K: int, tasks: list[str]) -> int:

preconditions.description: The number of tasks N is a positive integer between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
The cooldown period K is a non-negative integer between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The tasks list has exactly N elements, each being an uppercase English letter.

preconditions.expression: all('A' <= task <= 'Z' for task in tasks)
preconditions.description: Each task in the tasks list is an uppercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The returned minimum time is at least N, since each task takes one unit of time.

postconditions.expression: all(any(tasks[i] == tasks[j] and return_value - i >= j + K + 1 for j in range(i + 1, N) if tasks[i] == tasks[j]) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: For every pair of identical tasks at indices i and j (i < j), the time difference between their execution (return_value - i and j + 1) is at least K + 1 units apart.

There is no valid schedule of length less than return_value that satisfies the cooldown constraint for all tasks. The helper exists_schedule(tasks, K, T) is true if and only if there exists a valid schedule of length T that completes all tasks with cooldown K.
